ghr v0.9.1 adds commit-scoped pull request review and restores reliable automatic light/dark theme detection on newer macOS releases.

Highlights:

- Press `V`, click the commit count, or click a commit in the conversation to review one commit, a contiguous commit range, or the full pull request diff.
- The commit picker supports keyboard and mouse selection, fills gaps to keep ranges contiguous, and remembers the selected file and scroll position for each range.
- Inline review comments target the last commit in the selected range, while general PR comments remain available with `a`. Draft comments are kept separate for each commit selection.
- Commit comparisons use the pull request base and construct a virtual merge base across upstream merge commits, matching the web review model while preserving the selected branch side on conflicts.
- Commit-scoped comparisons require Git 2.46 or newer. Cached snapshots live under `~/.ghr/git-diffs/`, reuse the selected GitHub backend credentials, and expose retryable failures in the TUI.
- On macOS, `theme = "auto"` now determines light mode from the `defaults` command status instead of matching localized or version-specific error text. This fixes dark-theme fallback on macOS 27 while preserving automatic dark-mode detection.
- Updated Tokio and Octocrab patch releases for current runtime and GitHub API maintenance.

Install with Homebrew:

```bash
brew install chenyukang/tap/ghr-cli
```

Install the latest binary on macOS or Linux:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenyukang/ghr/main/install.sh | sh
```

Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenyukang/ghr/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cargo:

```bash
cargo install ghr-cli
```
